angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop Hoop G as a pass-rush tiebreaker after the 3-cone; baseline = log pick + weight + EDGE share + NGS + games per season + official 10-yd and 3-cone (filled in with a flag; observed-only models reported)
metric_name: Hoop G: peak half-second sideways (path-perpendicular) acceleration in the Run-the-Hoop drill, g, z within Combine year, adjusted for one-run reliability 0.41
headline_number: 0.6 extra pressures per 450-rush season per sd, 90% [-0.4, 1.7] (n=90), = pick 100 vs 80. Out of class on the same 90: rush-weighted nested R2 +0.013 [-0.047, 0.087], positive only in 2023; beats 300 within-class shuffles of the whole pipeline (p=0.01; 0.04 when shuffled Hoop G wins the screen). The count-model held-out log score (+0.58) fails the same control (shuffle median 1.39, p=0.89) and is dropped as evidence.
what_changed_from_previous: DS: pre-specified label-shuffle negative control (300 reruns of screen + reliability + prior + fit) for both log score and R2; rush-weighted nested R2 on all 90 replaces the n=63 R2 as the headline; observed-only models with reduced baseline (10-yd n=71, 3-cone n=37) for in-sample effect, log score and R2; run-to-run ICC from 10 players with 2 runs (0.37) and headline under it. Football: lede verdict 'unproven; tie-break after the 3-cone'; per-player trace takeaways for Robinson, Tuipulotu, Ezeiruaku, Phillips; film-first flags and 'already in the league' row removed; 2025 board cut to 4 rows with separate draft-day rule and rookie result columns; Phillips explained by the interior base rate (35% of no-call interior DL also clearly below). Writeup: two-sentence lede, 2-row top table, sensitivity into one checks table, jargon replaced, team-facing motivation and pooling rationale, 1,677 words. Viz: Fig 1 shared y-axis with his Hoop G line on NFL panels plus overlay of hoop vs NFL peaks; Fig 2 single pressure dot-and-interval on a common n=22 with power line; Fig 3 planning row + per-class rows + held-out R2 with shuffle bands; Fig 4 plus/minus blocks, 15 rows, 14-17 pt text, value inside sparkline, bold result labels. Graft from cand_3: rushers needed for 80% power (about 840, 40 classes).
open_risks: The common-n comparison (n=22) shows Hoop G at -0.01 vs 3-cone 0.33; with an observed 3-cone in the model the effect nearly vanishes (0.1), so the 'use when the 3-cone is missing' story rests on rushers without a 3-cone.
Out-of-class R2 gain is driven by one class (2023); the shuffle p partly reflects that other screened drills overfit, though p=0.04 holds conditional on shuffled Hoop G winning the screen.
The headline log score from earlier rounds is now shown to be uninformative (shuffles score higher); judges may ask why it was ever used.
All four plus-call hits are from 2023-24, the classes that helped choose the drill; pre-registered power is 0.12.
Per-player trace takeaways come from tracking of 20 sampled rushes, not film.
